QuestInfo.name: Even If You Forget Me
QuestInfo.0: The Fox God calls you, saying she has another gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: The Fox God calls you, saying she has another gift for you.
QuestInfo.2:
The Fox God gave you another gift--a spirit guardian that looks like Moonbeam.
It took her form because she's the person you care about the most in all the world.
